False positive: Package name confusion.
Detected package: Mono.Cecil.Mdb (cpe:2.3:a:cecil:cecil:0.11.5.0) Actual vulnerability: CVE-2023-4914 affects Cecil static site generator
The CVE targets "Cecil" - a Ruby-based static site generator. Mono.Cecil is an unrelated .NET library for reading/writing ECMA CIL. These are completely different projects by different maintainers.
- Cecil (vulnerable): https://github.com/bensheldon/cecil - Ruby static site generator - Mono.Cecil (not affected): https://github.com/jbevain/cecil - .NET IL manipulation library
Verified by: @copilot (PR #276) Date: 2024-12-19 Review: No expiration - permanent false positive Reference: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-4914

False positive: Package name confusion between JavaScript and .NET libraries.
Detected package: JsonPointer.Net.dll@6.0.1 (cpe:2.3:a:json-pointer_project:json-pointer) Actual vulnerability: CVE-2022-4742 affects json-pointer npm package (JavaScript)
The CVE targets "json-pointer" - a JavaScript npm package with prototype pollution. JsonPointer.Net is an unrelated .NET library implementing RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. These are completely different projects in different ecosystems:
- json-pointer (vulnerable): https://www.npmjs.com/package/json-pointer - JavaScript - JsonPointer.Net (not affected): https://www.nuget.org/packages/JsonPointer.Net - .NET
The vulnerability (CWE-1321: Prototype Pollution) is JavaScript-specific and cannot affect .NET code which doesn't have prototype-based inheritance.
Verified by: Claude Code (PR #282) Date: 2025-12-19 Review: No expiration - permanent false positive (different ecosystem) Reference: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2022-4742
